events.summary: Logan Green on the board since founding (proxy 'Director Since' 2007).
Ann Miura-Ko first stint ends (reason not disclosed).
Christodoro resigns before the IPO (between the 2019-03-01 S-1 and the 2019-03-18 S-1/A).
Horowitz does not stand for re-election; term ends at 2020 annual meeting.
Authorized directors expected to decrease 9 -> 8 after the 2020 annual meeting (proxy says 'anticipated').
Ariel Cohen appointed (Class III; compensation committee).
David Risher appointed as independent director (NCG).
Green moves from CEO to Board Chair.
Aggarwal moves from Chair to Lead Independent Director.
Stephenson becomes audit committee chair, replacing Wilderotter.
Miura-Ko does not stand for re-election; term ends at 2023 annual meeting.
Authorized directors to decrease 10 -> 9 after the 2023 annual meeting.
Zimmer leaves the President role and becomes a non-employee director; stays Vice Chair.
Janey Whiteside appointed (board action 2023-07-24; effective 2023-07-31; Class II; compensation).
Cohen resigns effective immediately; withdrawn as a 2025 nominee.
Aggarwal moves from Lead Independent Director to Board Chair (day of appointment not stated).

context_events.summary: IPO priced 2019-03-28, first trade 2019-03-29. Nine directors at IPO, classified into Class I/II/III; seven found independent.
2026 proxy: eight directors (seven independent). Minicucci joined later (2026-07-23), so nine is implied; not stated.
Class I: Green, Miura-Ko elected to 2023.
Class I: Green, Risher, Stephenson elected to 2026.
Class II: Zimmer, Lawee, Whiteside elected to 2027.
Engine Capital nominated Alan L. Bazaar and Daniel B. Silvers, then withdrew them after Lyft's 2025-05-08 buyback announcement. No settlement or cooperation agreement and no directors added.
Class III: Aggarwal, Beggs, Stevenson elected to 2028.
Founders elected to convert all Class B (20 votes/share) into Class A at 5:00 p.m. ET on 2025-08-15, the day after they left the board.
Class I: Risher, Hersman, Stephenson elected to 2029; charter amended to remove Class B references.
Michael Brous replaces Erin Brewer as CFO. Neither is a director; listed only to show the latest 5.02 8-K and Form 3 are not board changes.

conflicts.description: Aggarwal's second chair start day is ambiguous. The 8-K cover gives the 'earliest event reported' as 2025-08-13. Green's resignation was effective 2025-08-14, and the 8-K Item 5.02 and press release are dated 2025-08-14. The 2026 proxy says only 'August 2025'. Recorded at month precision.

The 2023-03-27 press release says the founders move into 'non-executive roles as chair and vice chair ... effective April 17, 2023 and June 30, 2023, respectively'. That reads as if Zimmer's Vice Chair role began 2023-06-30, but the prospectus and every proxy say he had been Vice Chair since January 2019, and the 8-K says he 'will continue to serve as Vice Chair'. June 30, 2023 is when he stopped being an executive.

Founding year: proxies give Logan Green 'Director Since 2007' and the company was incorporated in 2007 (as Bounder Web, Inc.), but the 2025-08-14 press release's boilerplate says Lyft was 'Founded in 2012' (the Lyft brand launch). Green's board start is kept at 2007, year precision, per the proxy table.

Board-size bookkeeping has gaps. The 2023 proxy says the board would be nine after the 2023 meeting, yet the October 2023 8-K reduces authorized directors 'from ten to eight'. That implies an undisclosed increase to ten when Whiteside joined (2023-07-31). Likewise no filing states the increases for Cohen, Risher, Stephenson, Stevenson, Beggs, Hersman or Minicucci. Only disclosed changes are recorded as BOARD_SIZE_CHANGE events.

open_questions: Ben Minicucci (appointed 2026-07-23): no committee assignment and no independence determination in any filing through 2026-10-04. The next proxy (expected ~April 2027) should settle both. His 8-K reports the Lyft-Alaska Airlines partnership as an Item 404 transaction.
Current authorized board size after Minicucci's appointment is not stated. The 2026 proxy gives eight directors, so nine is implied, but no filing says so.
Exact day of Aggarwal's August 2025 appointment as Chair (2025-08-13 vs 2025-08-14). See conflicts.
Exact day of Christodoro's March 2019 resignation (between 2019-03-01 and 2019-03-18). He was never a director of the public company.
Pre-IPO start dates are disclosed only to the month (or, for Logan Green, the year). No filing gives a day.
When Risher stopped being independent is not dated: he left the NCG in March 2023 and became CEO on 2023-04-17.
Independence roles are aligned to board tenure. The filings give point-in-time determinations only (IPO prospectus and each proxy).
Why Ann Miura-Ko's first stint ended (May 2013) is not disclosed.

Other-board lists come from Lyft's own bios as of each filing and are not checked against other issuers' filings. Many bios name a company without saying it is public (flagged with public_company_stated_in_source=false).

Committee membership is captured at proxy snapshots plus changes disclosed in 8-Ks and proxies. Changes between filings may exist without a disclosed date (e.g., when Cohen left the compensation committee is not separately disclosed; he resigned 2025-05-22).

coverage.method: Current roster checked against the 2026 DEF 14A and every 8-K, 10-Q and Form 3/4 filed through 2026-10-02.
Every DEF 14A/DEFC14A, every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07, and the IPO prospectus reviewed; departures dated from 8-Ks.
Pre-IPO seats reconstructed from the IPO prospectus and later proxy biographies only; pre-2019 departures appear only where those documents mention them.
